music.key: D major (city pop: maj9, dominant 7 and minor 9 chords)
music.notes: Two bars of electric piano alone (Gmaj9, F#7) while the camera pulls back; the groove comes in with the dive on the city-pop turn Gmaj9 | F#7 | Bm9 | Am9 D9; the lead takes the hook at 12.0 (the life) and 19.2 (the seasons); the groove stops on a last hit at 24.6 and the end lands on Em9 - A7sus - Dmaj9 with bells, fading over the last second.

sfx.role: the Shibuya scramble's crossing signal when the green man comes on (0.3 s), repeating fainter as the camera pulls back
sfx.source: code-original, audio/sfx.py: a soft electronic cuckoo (two falling sine notes), after the calls of Tokyo's pedestrian crossings

sfx.role: words and the 東京 seal stamped on like a hanko
sfx.source: code-original, audio/sfx.py: a muted thock (low body, a felt pat)

sfx.role: the pull-backs: from the scramble to the whole city (3 s), from the Sumida to the whole city in the snow (1.8 s)
sfx.source: code-original, audio/sfx.py: a soft falling whoosh, band-passed pink noise

sfx.role: the dive from the whole city into Tokyo Tower
sfx.source: code-original, audio/sfx.py: a soft rising whoosh
code-original, audio/sfx.py: a short wooden tick pitched to D major

sfx.role: a season brushed on by the page's wipe (three times)
sfx.source: code-original, audio/sfx.py: a broad, smooth brush swish on the wipe's own ease

placement: audio/cues.py writes plan.json audio.cues at the action times from the shot code; syncOffset is each file's onset measured with sfx_landmarks.py; mix_audio.py mixes and ducks the music under the stamps.
